recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12635 unless PA opens a new decision to revisit the broader Encounter status/businessStatus model.
issue_request: FHIR-12635 asked whether Encounter.status, which is required and required-bound, should include an unknown value for systems that cannot map to an existing status. The final PA resolution added code unknown with a last-resort definition and rejected adding other or changing Encounter.status to 0..1.
initial_application: Git commit d562f07e0ff1abf6b607baacde81c2a276e3214e, whose message included tracker 12635, added unknown to the Encounter status lists and added the exact unknown definition to the encounter-status terminology sheet. Later source refactors moved this content into source/encounter/codesystem-encounter-status.xml and source/encounter/valueset-encounter-status.xml.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Later PA issues FHIR-13702, FHIR-22726, and FHIR-47297 changed adjacent Encounter status modeling by splitting patient/waiting state into subjectStatus, adding discharged, and adding businessStatus for granular workflows; these decisions retained unknown and do not require adding other or loosening Encounter.status cardinality. Those related issues already have separate reconcile commits on the combined branch.
